items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: We're the best of friends. Sure, Jimmy and Mabel and Brick and all of us, we get together. That's my group.

ctx.x: Yeah. I went to London and bought one of those His "Master's Voice". We call it a grammaphone. I bought a little grammaphone. And the old fellow that I know came up to visit -- Al Fair had a friend to come in to visit him. Al Fair just came up to visit Harry and my brother and different ones. And I always believe he stole mine, because somebody broke into my apartment. And I always think Al Fair stole it. I'll always think so. And that's the reason, when Jimmy says, Al Fair says hello, I say, tell him I never…

So I bought this little grammaphone, and I used to play the different records. But I never bothered playing mine. Isn't that funny. You know, I never open my mouth to sing a song. Never. Uh-huh, no. So that's the only grammaphone I had -- record player like, you know. That's the only one I had,
